title: Efficient strategies for the preparation of non-noble metal catalysts for electrocatalytic glycerol oxidation towards high-value-added chemicals
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20513-20529
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02222C, Review Article

Mingyang Song, Yitong Bai, Jiefei Li, Xingyue Qi
This paper reviews the recent progress on non-noble catalysts for the GEOR, discussing in detail how their synthesis strategies (doping engineering, alloying strategies, etc.) improve their GEOR performance.
